entities.summary: Shōsetsuka ni Narō  is a Japanese novel self-publishing website created by Yusuke Umezaki . It was launched on April 2, 2004. Users can upload their novels free of charge and the novels are also free to read. As of December 2022, the site hosts close to 1,000,000 novels, has over 2,300,000 registered users and it receives over 1 billion page views per month.
